aviato_findings.title: Generic or non-descriptive alt / aria-label values on content images
aviato_findings.explanation: axe-core passes any non-empty alt string, even generic placeholders like alt="image" or alt="product-img". Screen-reader shoppers hear repetitive role words instead of product details.

aviato_findings.title: CSS removes :focus outline (outline: 0 / none) without a visible focus indicator
examples: css/style.css: a, a:focus, a:hover { text-decoration: none; outline: 0; color: #000; }
aviato_findings.explanation: Static axe-core DOM checks do not fail stylesheets that strip :focus outlines, leaving keyboard-only users unable to see where focus is on the page.

aviato_findings.title: Form controls relying on placeholder text without a persistent <label>
examples: index.html: <input type="text" placeholder="Enter Your Email Address"> (no <label>)
aviato_findings.explanation: Placeholders vanish as soon as a user types and often have low contrast; every input needs an explicit <label> or persistent accessible name.

diagnosis.headline: The template exhibits pervasive link naming, color contrast, and missing accessible name issues, compounded by CSS that hides focus outlines and reliance on placeholder text, impairing screen‑reader and keyboard users.

shared_root_causes.title: Non-descriptive link text (missing accessible name)
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Provide clear, descriptive link text or use aria-label/visually hidden text for icon-only links.

shared_root_causes.title: Insufficient color contrast
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Adjust foreground/background color combinations to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text).

shared_root_causes.title: Generic or non-descriptive alt text on content images
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Low (axe passes any non-empty alt, missing descriptive value)
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Replace placeholder alt values (e.g., "image") with concise descriptions that convey the image’s purpose or content.

shared_root_causes.title: CSS removes :focus outline without visible indicator
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Low (axe does not detect CSS outline removal)
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Retain a visible focus indicator (e.g., outline, border, or background change) or provide an equivalent style that meets WCAG 2.4.7 focus visible.

shared_root_causes.title: Form controls rely on placeholder text without persistent label
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Low (axe passes inputs with placeholder but no label)
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Associate each input with a <label> element (or aria-label/aria-labelledby) and keep placeholder only as a supplementary hint.

diagnosis.why_axe_alone_is_not_enough: Although axe‑core flags missing link names and insufficient contrast, it passes generic alt text, missing visible focus indicators, and placeholder‑only inputs. These three Placebo‑detected problems create real barriers for screen‑reader and keyboard navigation that axe alone would overlook.
